mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_PLAN (USER_ID, TITLE, PLACE, PLAN_AT, SHARED_YN, REPEAT_ID) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{place}, #{planAt}, #{shared}, #{repeatId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_PLAN WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PLAN_AT >= #{from}

SELECT P.ID AS "id" ,P.USER_ID AS "ownerId" ,P.TITLE AS "title" ,P.PLACE AS "place" ,P.PLAN_AT AS "planAt" ,P.SHARED_YN AS "shared" ,P.REPEAT_ID AS "repeatId" FROM T_PLAN P WHERE 1=1 AND (P.USER_ID = #{userId} OR (P.USER_ID = #{partnerId} AND P.SHARED_YN = 'Y')) AND P.PLAN_AT >= #{from} AND P.PLAN_AT < #{to} ORDER BY P.PLAN_AT, P.ID LIMIT 100
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_PLAN WHERE ID = #{id} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT P.USER_ID AS "userId" ,P.SHARED_YN AS "shared" ,P.TITLE AS "title" ,P.PLACE AS "place" ,P.PLAN_AT AS "planAt" FROM T_PLAN P JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = P.USER_ID AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL WHERE 1=1 AND P.PLAN_AT >= #{from} AND P.PLAN_AT < #{to} ORDER BY P.USER_ID, P.PLAN_AT, P.ID
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_PLAN WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND REPEAT_ID = (SELECT R.REPEAT_ID FROM T_PLAN R WHERE R.ID = #{id} AND R.USER_ID = #{userId}) AND PLAN_AT >= (SELECT R.PLAN_AT FROM T_PLAN R WHERE R.ID = #{id} AND R.USER_ID = #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE T_PLAN SET REPEAT_ID = #{repeatId} WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT N.TITLE AS "title" ,S.NAME AS "stock" FROM T_WATCHLIST W JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = W.STOCK_ID JOIN T_NEWS N ON N.STOCK_ID = W.STOCK_ID WHERE W.USER_ID = #{userId} AND N.PUB_DATE >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day' ORDER BY N.PUB_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MORNING_YN AS "morning" ,CLOSE_YN AS "close" ,REGION AS "region" FROM T_VOICE_BRIEF WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_VOICE_BRIEF (USER_ID, MORNING_YN, CLOSE_YN, REGION) VALUES (#{userId}, #{morning}, #{close}, #{region}) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID) DO UPDATE SET MORNING_YN = EXCLUDED.MORNING_YN ,CLOSE_YN = EXCLUDED.CLOSE_YN ,REGION = EXCLUDED.REGION ,UPD_DAY = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT V.USER_ID AS "userId" ,U.NICKNAME AS "nickname" ,V.REGION AS "region" FROM T_VOICE_BRIEF V JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = V.USER_ID AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL WHERE V.MORNING_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY V.USER_ID
SELECT V.USER_ID AS "userId" ,U.NICKNAME AS "nickname" FROM T_VOICE_BRIEF V JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = V.USER_ID AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL WHERE V.CLOSE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY V.USER_ID
SELECT NICKNAME FROM T_USER WHERE ID = #{userId}

SELECT W.STOCK_ID AS "stockId" ,S.NAME AS "name" ,(SELECT P.CLOSE_PRICE FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P WHERE P.STOCK_ID = W.STOCK_ID AND P.TRADE_DATE < #{today} ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC LIMIT 1) AS "prev" ,(SELECT P.CLOSE_PRICE FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P WHERE P.STOCK_ID = W.STOCK_ID AND P.TRADE_DATE = #{today} LIMIT 1) AS "todayClose" FROM T_WATCHLIST W JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = W.STOCK_ID WHERE W.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY W.CREATED_AT LIMIT 30
